facts: Post (verbatim): looking for a company that is fluent in English that is qualified to manage the go high level agency account. you need to be an expert in go high level
Hourly, expert, part-time, 2 hires, US-only location required. No screening questions returned.

Client signals (private, not shown): US (NY) repeat GHL hirer; past contracts include A2P brand registrations and Twilio help. Phone/A2P appears in the deck only as a standard GHL sub-account setup step, never as a claimed approval count.

scenes.title: Set up every new client's sub-account the same way.
scenes.caption: One tag starts it. The account manager, onboarding stage, checklist and follow-up happen in order.
scenes.beat: When a new client signs, like {{client.name}} here, one tag starts this workflow. {{manager.first}} is assigned as the account manager, the onboarding stage moves to Snapshot loaded, and {{client.first}} gets the checklist for her phone number and A2P registration. When the checklist comes back, {{manager.first}} gets told it's ready to submit and test. If it doesn't come back, {{client.first}} gets a reminder text instead.
